en: Vintage commemorative postcard featuring an oval portrait of a seated man writing (the poet Bocage) framed between two stylized trees. Around the portrait are books, a quill, nautical instruments, and an old sailing ship. A banner at the top reads "PRIMEIRO CENTENARIO DE BOCAGE". Near the bottom is a circular seal of the Biblioteca Nacional de Lisboa with a crown and shield, and printed text indicating the publisher's collection and the location "Setubal – PORTUGAL." The design is in muted tones of black, red, and beige.
